news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 23%
news.body: After last week's 23% share price gain to ₹213, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 14x. Average forward P/E is 18x in the Construction industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 1.8% over the past year.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 22%
news.body: After last week's 22% share price gain to ₹168, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 11x. Average forward P/E is 15x in the Construction industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 21% over the past year.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.4% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. This is currently the only risk that has been identified for the company.

news.title: Now 23% undervalued after recent price drop
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 28% to ₹161. The fair value is estimated to be ₹208, however this is not to be taken as a buy recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has grown by 33% over the last 3 years. Earnings per share has grown by 28%. Revenue is forecast to grow by 105% in 2 years. Earnings are forecast to grow by 84% in the next 2 years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.30 (vs ₹2.59 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.30. Revenue: ₹2.58b (up 4.5% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹404.1m (up 10% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 16% (in line with 3Q 2025).

news.title: Enviro Infra Engineers Limited Approves Appointment of Mukul Jain as Non-Executive Independent Director, Effective October 4, 2025
news.body: Enviro Infra Engineers Limited appointed Dr. Mukul Jain (DIN: 07187651) as Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company for a period of five years, effective from October 4, 2025, following the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and approval of the shareholders through remote e-voting via postal ballot with requisite majority on January 1, 2026. Dr. Mukul Jain is a mechanical engineering graduate with three post-graduations in different domains of management, namely Operations, Finance & HR. He holds a Ph.D. degree in the subject of behavioural finance. He is a Corporate Trainer and visiting Professor in management domain with various business institutes. Dr. Mukul Jain is not related to any of the Directors of the Company.
